author: Ethan Morgan
title: Judge Rips Colorado Prosecutors For Hiding Key Arson Evidence In 2003 Fire That Killed Three Kids - NewsBreak
text:
By Ethan Morgan ,
6 hours ago A Colorado judge has ruled that prosecutors withheld critical scientific evidence in the arson case against Deborah Nicholls, the Colorado Springs mother convicted in 2008 in connection with a 2003 fire that killed her three children. In an April 28 order, Senior District Court Judge R. Michael Mullins set an evidentiary hearing for May 27, a date that could become a turning point in a case that has been locked in place for nearly two decades. Read full article
